@graph.name: Flit - Note Taking & Personal Knowledge Management | Features
@graph.description: Organize notes with categories, bi-directional links, and color coding. Transcribe voice locally on Android, sync with encrypted backup on Flit Core, import/export freely, and connect AI tools via MCP.

@graph.name: What you can do with Flit

itemListElement.name: Personal Note Taking and Knowledge Management
itemListElement.description: Flit is first and foremost a note taking app. Naturally, that requires the ability to manage your notes and build a knowledge base. This includes bi-directional relation mapping and the categorization of notes, 'pinned' status and color coding.

itemListElement.name: Voice Transcription
itemListElement.description: The Android app features 100% local voice note transcription, with optional online transcription and formatting.

itemListElement.name: Multi-Device Sync and Secure Backup
itemListElement.description: Flit - Core allows you to sync your notes across web and your devices. Automatic backups give you total peace of mind. The database your online notes are stored in, features 'at rest' and 'in transit' encryption.

itemListElement.name: Full Import & Export
itemListElement.description: Bring your existing notes from other apps or export everything whenever you want. Your data is never locked in.

itemListElement.name: MCP Server
itemListElement.description: Flit - Core features a MCP server, allowing your AI tools to access your notes and manage your knowledge base.

@graph.name: Flit - Note Taking & Personal Knowledge Management | About
@graph.description: Flit is a simple, private note-taking and PKM tool built for daily use—easy, secure, and improved continuously by its creator. No clutter, no complex systems.

@graph.name: Flit - Note Taking & Personal Knowledge Management | Apps
@graph.description: Explore the Flit ecosystem: Still meditation journal, Inkpot AI writing, and more apps for personal knowledge management.

itemListElement.name: Still
itemListElement.description: An elegant meditation timer and journal for the Flit ecosystem. Track sessions, set goals, and optionally sync journal entries with Flit Core.

itemListElement.name: Inkpot
itemListElement.description: AI-enhanced writing webapp for the Flit ecosystem. Write, edit, and publish with AI suggestions and sources from your Flit Core database.
